name: Mobile Navigation Clarity
description: The app makes it easy for users to understand where they are, move between screens, and return to previous areas without confusion.
aliases: mobile navigation| bottom nav| tabs| wayfinding| app navigation
examples: I always knew which tab I was in.  I could not find my way back to the previous screen.  The bottom navigation made the main sections easy to reach.

name: Gesture Discoverability
description: Touch gestures such as swiping, long pressing, dragging, or pinching are understandable, discoverable, and supported by visible cues when needed.
aliases: gestures| swipe actions| long press| touch interaction| gesture cues
examples: I did not realize I could swipe the card to delete it.  The drag handle made the gesture obvious.  Long pressing opened options I did not expect.

name: Touch Target Usability
description: Buttons, icons, links, and controls are large enough, spaced well, and easy to tap accurately on a mobile screen.
aliases: tap targets| touch targets| button size| mobile controls| thumb-friendly
examples: The buttons were easy to tap with one hand.  I kept hitting the wrong icon.  The small close button was frustrating to use.

name: One-Handed Use
description: Important actions and navigation elements are reachable and comfortable to use when holding the phone with one hand.
aliases: thumb reach| reachability| one-hand mode| hand comfort| mobile ergonomics
examples: The main action was easy to reach with my thumb.  The save button was too high on the screen.  I had to use both hands to finish the task.

name: Screen Space Management
description: The app uses limited mobile screen space effectively, showing enough information without overcrowding the interface or hiding essential actions.
aliases: small screen layout| screen density| compact layout| mobile layout| space usage
examples: The screen showed the right amount of detail.  Everything felt cramped.  Important controls disappeared behind too much content.

name: Mobile Onboarding
description: The app introduces key features, permissions, and first actions in a way that helps users begin successfully without unnecessary delay.
aliases: app onboarding| first launch| guided setup| intro screens| getting started
examples: The first-use flow helped me set up my profile quickly.  The onboarding screens were too long.  I skipped the tutorial and then felt lost.

name: Permission Request Clarity
description: Requests for access to location, camera, contacts, notifications, health data, or other phone permissions are clearly explained and timed appropriately.
aliases: permissions| privacy prompts| location access| camera access| notification permission
examples: The app explained why it needed location access.  I was asked for contacts before understanding the feature.  The permission request felt suspicious.

name: Notification Usefulness
description: Push notifications, reminders, alerts, and badges are timely, relevant, understandable, and not unnecessarily disruptive.
aliases: push notifications| alerts| reminders| badges| notification relevance
examples: The reminder arrived at a useful time.  I received too many notifications.  The alert text did not explain what needed my attention.

name: Offline and Connectivity Handling
description: The app handles weak signal, offline states, retries, syncing, and reconnection gracefully without losing user progress or creating confusion.
aliases: offline mode| connectivity| sync issues| network handling| retry behavior
examples: My changes synced when I came back online.  The app failed without explaining the network problem.  I lost my draft after the connection dropped.

name: Mobile Performance
description: The app loads quickly, responds smoothly to touch interactions, and avoids lag, freezes, excessive battery drain, or slow transitions.
aliases: app speed| responsiveness| lag| loading time| battery impact
examples: The app opened quickly.  Scrolling felt laggy.  The screen froze after I tapped submit.

name: Data Entry Effort
description: Forms, text input, selections, and repeated data entry are optimized for mobile use and minimize typing burden.
aliases: forms| mobile input| typing effort| autofill| data entry friction
examples: Autofill saved me time.  Entering the same information twice was annoying.  The keyboard covered the field I was editing.

name: Error Prevention and Recovery
description: The app helps users avoid mistakes and recover from errors through clear messages, undo options, validation, and safe confirmation patterns.
aliases: error handling| undo| validation| recovery| mistake prevention
examples: The app warned me before deleting the item.  I could undo the accidental action.  The error message did not tell me how to fix the problem.

name: Personalization and Preferences
description: The app allows users to adjust settings, recommendations, notifications, appearance, and behavior in ways that match their needs.
aliases: personalization| preferences| customization| settings| tailored experience
examples: I could choose which reminders to receive.  The recommendations did not match my habits.  I could not find where to change my preferences.

name: Cross-Device Continuity
description: The app supports a consistent experience across phones, tablets, wearables, and web versions, including reliable syncing and state preservation.
aliases: device sync| continuity| handoff| multi-device| cross-platform
examples: My progress appeared on my tablet immediately.  The phone and watch showed different data.  I had to restart the task on another device.

name: Accessibility on Mobile
description: The app supports mobile accessibility needs, including readable text, sufficient contrast, screen reader compatibility, focus order, captions, and reduced-motion options.
aliases: mobile accessibility| screen reader| contrast| dynamic text| reduced motion
examples: The app worked well with larger text.  The contrast made the labels hard to read.  The screen reader did not announce the button clearly.

name: Privacy and Trust Cues
description: The app communicates data use, account security, privacy settings, and sensitive actions in ways that help users feel informed and in control.
aliases: privacy| trust| security cues| data use| account safety
examples: I understood how my data would be used.  The privacy settings were easy to review.  The app asked for personal information without context.

name: Visual Feedback and System Status
description: The app clearly shows when actions are processing, completed, failed, saved, synced, or awaiting user attention.
aliases: feedback| system status| loading state| confirmation| progress indicator
examples: The checkmark confirmed my change was saved.  I tapped twice because nothing seemed to happen.  The upload progress bar helped me wait confidently.

name: Content and Label Fit
description: Text, labels, icons, and content are concise, understandable, and well adapted to the constraints of mobile screens.
aliases: mobile copy| labels| icon clarity| text fit| truncation
examples: The label explained the action clearly.  The title was cut off and hard to understand.  The icon alone was not enough to know what it did.

name: Media and Sensor Integration
description: Features using the camera, microphone, GPS, biometrics, motion sensors, or media library feel reliable, understandable, and easy to control.
aliases: camera| microphone| GPS| sensors| media picker
examples: The camera opened exactly when I expected.  Location tracking stopped without explanation.  Choosing a photo from my library was simple.

name: Account and Session Management
description: Sign-in, sign-out, account switching, password recovery, session expiration, and authentication flows are clear and do not block users unnecessarily.
aliases: login| authentication| account switching| session| password recovery
examples: I reset my password without leaving the app.  The session expired while I was completing a task.  Switching accounts was easier than expected.
